title: Yellow Lentil Grill
description: A hearty vegan dish made with yellow lentils and a smoky grill flavor.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the lentil seasoning and grill seasoning to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the soaked lentils, salt, and 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Meanwhile, preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Once the lentils are cooked, add them to a grill-safe container and grill for 5-7 minutes or until lightly charred.
Serve the grilled lentils hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
